localContext: Mount Prospect, IL, has many homes built in the 1950s and 60s. These brick ranches and split-levels often have their original attached garages. Many still use single-skin, un-insulated steel garage doors from that era. These older doors flex and bind, especially in deep cold. On subzero January days, these doors visibly bow inward. This bowing stresses the tracks and overworks garage door openers. In neighborhoods like We-Go Park, older springs fatigue faster due to constant strain. Cold metal contracts, making parts brittle. This combination leads to snapped springs, cables off drums, or doors coming off their tracks. We understand these specific challenges for Mount Prospect homeowners in Cook County.
